Author: Anil Kumar Choudhary
Bench: Anil Kumar Choudhary
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Aba No. 5839 of 2023
 Sanjay Nayak @ Sanjay Kumar Nayak ... Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand & Anr. ... Opposite Parties
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Avishek Prasad , Adv.
 For the State : Ms. Lily Sahay, Addl. PP 05 / 18.08.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 05 of 2017 (G.R. No. 80 of 2017) registered for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner along with the Santosh Nayak has brought Malviya Prasad to the office of Sub- Registrar to put his signature in the sale deed as a witness.

It is next submitted that though the petitioner is not named in the FIR but drawing attention of the court to order dated 15.07.2023, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the JMFC, Ranchi has issued non-bailable warrant of arrest against the petitioner on the false submissions made by I.O. before him that the petitioner is the named accused in the case and learned JMFC, Ranchi also without application of mind, has accepted the submission of the I.O. that the petitioner is named accused person of the case.
It is next submitted that the allegation against the petitioner is false and the petitioner is not named accused of the case.

It is next submitted that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case and co-accused with similar allegations have already been granted privilege of anticipatory bail by this court vide order dated 14.02.2019 passed in ABA no. 7329 of 2018 hence,
the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail on the principle of parity.
The learned Addl. PP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of Sanjay Nayak @ Sanjay Kumar Nayak vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ...

Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned JMFC, Ranchi in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 05 of 2017 (G.R. No. 80 of 2017) subject to the condition that the petitioner will co-operate with the Investigation of the case and will appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will submit mobile number and photocopy of Aadhaar card at the time of surrender in the court below with an undertaking not to change mobile number during the pendency of the case along with the other conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C. (ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)
Smita/-
